description: Election Commission - Declare that N. Mohanrajah as Member of the Eravurpattu P/S
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Eravur Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters and declarations related to local authority elections.
